mapper.select: SELECT FA_TITLE FROM ( SELECT FA_TITLE FROM FAQ_TB WHERE FA_SHOW = 'Y' ORDER BY FA_MODIFY_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, FA_REG_DATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT FA_CONTENT FROM ( SELECT FA_CONTENT FROM FAQ_TB WHERE FA_SHOW = 'Y' AND UPPER(TRIM(FA_TITLE)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{title})) ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
